items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 107:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot of the head of Atik are called the head that is not known (Rosh de Lo Etyada), and the reason is that in them serves the Malchut of the first restriction, as in AK, and there this Malchut was concealed, because for the sake of Arich Anpin it serves in the Malchut of the second restriction. Hence it is called RDLA (Rosh de Lo Etyada), for 'knowing' means coupling, and it indicates that upon its Malchut there is no longer any coupling in all the Partzufim of ABYA. (Page 301, Item 9).
